Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Apex for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 29 (Kids Holiday Craft Fair) through December 31 (Holiday Tour of Lights), with the Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 4), the Apex Rotary Christmas Parade (December 5) and Infinity Ballet Nutcracker Dances (December 4 to 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
